<translated_code>
import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    P = int(data[0])
    K = int(data[1])
    if K == 0:
        print(pow(P, P - 1, MOD))
        return
    if K == 1:
        print(pow(P, P, MOD))
        return
    visited = set()
    p = 1
    cnt = 0
    while p not in visited:
        visited.add(p)
        cnt += 1
        p = (K * p) % P
    print(pow(P, P // cnt, MOD))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</translated_code>
